investigation_notes.Description: Anomalous activity from 194.126.101.99 by andrus.kivi@globalcorp.ee with Contributor access included a DELETE of a virtual network peering and subsequent NSG-related changes in the Baltic prod core environment. The action occurred at 22:50 UTC, corresponding to about 00:50 local Estonian time, which is outside typical admin hours in Estonia and from a Tallinn-based location. The sequence of changes increases risk to connectivity and security controls, suggesting potential unauthorized or high-risk activity that requires escalation.
